scope: Replacement for pointwise-uniform-errors, placed after the uniform convergence definition in the univariate integration chapter.
label: fig:analysis-process-convergence-modes

scientific_review.question: 一致收敛：同一N(ε)对全部输入成立；逐点收敛：N依赖于输入，不存在共同N。

facts.band: |value-0|<epsilon, i.e. (-epsilon, epsilon) around the limit function 0

left.N_check: 1/8=0.125>=0.12, 1/9=0.111<0.12; for n>=9 the whole graph lies in the band

right.N_rule: smallest n with x^n<epsilon; then x^m<epsilon for all m>=n
right.exit_rule: x=epsilon^(1/n): f_n(x)>=epsilon for x>=epsilon^(1/n), so sup_{[0,1)} f_n=1 for every n

facts.sampling: 801 uniform points on [0,1] (left) and [0,0.9995] (right; 0.9995^32=0.984); N and exit points computed analytically

scientific_review.basis: Analytic identities: sup|x/n|=1/n; N(x,eps)=min{n: x^n<eps}; x^n>=eps exactly for x>=eps^(1/n). Plotted finite n do not replace proofs.

reader_review.caption: 函数列的两种收敛方式，绿色带为极限$0$附近宽$\varepsilon=0.12$的误差带。(a)一致收敛：$g_n(x)=x/n$在$[0,1]$上的最大误差为$1/n$，$n=2,4$时图形超出误差带，从$N=9$起（图中加粗）整个图形都在带内。(b)逐点收敛：$f_n(x)=x^n$在$[0,1)$上趋于$0$，图绘$n=2,8,32$。竖虚线$x_1=0.5$、$x_2=0.9$上的实心点是各曲线在该处的值，进入误差带所需的下标分别为$N(x_1)=4$、$N(x_2)=21$；空心点标出各曲线离开误差带的位置$x=\varepsilon^{1/n}$，约为$0.35,0.77,0.94$。右端空心圆表示$x=1$不在定义域内。有限条曲线只示意定义中的量词次序，不代替收敛的证明。
reader_review.notes: Caption values match facts: N=9, N(x1)=4, N(x2)=21, exit points 0.35, 0.77, 0.94; body text explains the quantifier order before the figure.

visual_review.findings: Standalone 360 dpi PNG inspected: inline n labels and N(x_1), N(x_2) labels clear of curves; band and axis lines stop at the plotted domain in (a) so right-margin labels sit on white.
